areas.new_evidence: Exact target-population contrasts, weight concentration and specified bias scenarios
areas.limits: Identification assumptions remain substantive; synthetic potential means are not external causal evidence.

areas.new_evidence: Eligible group-time contrasts, sequential enumeration, IPW and information-time contracts
areas.limits: The worked mechanisms do not replace design-specific inference for a real staggered or dynamic study.

areas.new_evidence: Actual vintage leakage contrast, covariance-weighted reconciliation and asymmetric decision loss
areas.limits: Small deterministic scenarios do not establish general forecasting superiority or interval calibration.

areas.new_evidence: Risk-set likelihood oracle, fitted censored Weibull and coherent incidence calculations
areas.limits: Residual-style diagnostics are labeled mechanisms; external PH assumptions and censoring need review.

areas.new_evidence: Candidate ceilings, trained pairwise scorer with gradient oracle and exact logged-policy values
areas.limits: This is not an internet-scale serving system or an assertion that historical clicks identify preferences.

areas.new_evidence: Real LP/MILP, independent enumeration, local sensitivity and finite-scenario information value
areas.limits: Estimated coefficients, unknown scenarios and normative constraints need additional evidence.

areas.new_evidence: Estimated heterogeneity, predictive vs mean uncertainty, GLS dependence and explicit missing-study scenario
areas.limits: Tiny-study normal approximations are not claimed calibrated; scenario rows are not invented observed studies.

areas.new_evidence: Moran graph contrasts, blocked split edges, design expectation and covariance-derived clustering effect
areas.limits: Spatial exchangeability, population support and actual sampling design remain explicit assumptions.

areas.new_evidence: Rank-deficiency oracle, independent prediction and data-to-decision rollback ledger
areas.limits: Coefficient uniqueness under regularization is distinct from scientific identification and decision validity.
